title: Zoho CRM Pricing and Editions - Free for 3 users
text:
Zoho CRM Pricing and Editions - Free for 3 users

# Close more. Pay less.

- Free Onboarding
- Built-in AI Agents
- Human Support

Free

Features List Features List

Forever free, for 3 users

- Contact management Manage all contacts important to your business in one place. No more scattered business cards.
- Follow-up reminders Stay on track with timely reminders to follow-up on a lead.
- Workflow automation Automate repetitive tasks with workflows. From routing leads to the right rep to updating fields when a deal is closed.
- Custom email templates Personalize emails to fit the tone of your business. Get up to 10 custom emai templates for free.
- Tasks, meetings & calls Track all sales activities in Zoho CRM. Get reminders so don't miss.
- Data import and export Import data from spreadsheets for free. Export data from Zoho CRM for up to 10 times for free.
- Standard reports View your business performance in one place with powerful reports.
- APIs Connect Zoho CRM to any app and perform actions with 5000 API calls/day.
- Mobile apps Sell more on the go with Zoho CRM's mobile app.

Standard/user/month

Standard

Features List Features List

Small team, getting started

- Email integration & mass emails Send emails via Gmail, Outlook, Zoho Mail, and other popular email services, directly from Zoho CRM.
- Built-in calling Make, receive, and log sales calls directly inside Zoho CRM.
- Multiple sales pipelines Track multiple sales operations with different stages without any clutter.
- Calendar integration Schedule and book meetings from within Zoho CRM. 
- Data capture via forms Generate leads from anywhere with built-in forms. 
- Sales forecasting Set your team for long-term success with achievable goals and keep track of business performance.
- Data enrichment Enrich your records to get more context about your leads like company size, industry, revenue, and more.
- Custom modules Build custom modules to hold data unique to your business. 
- HIPAA compliance Store and manage patient or health-related data in Zoho CRM without risking regulatory violations.
- Gmail and Outlook integration Integrate Gmail, Outlook, Zoho Mail, and other popular email service providers with Zoho CRM.
- Slack, Zoom, Teams integration Integrate popular video conferencing and collaboration tools with Zoho CRM.

Most Popular

Professional/user/month

Professional

Features List Features List

Growing team, needs automation

- AI agents Build and deploy AI agents that execute tasks on your behalf for any business use case.
- Process management Standardize and automate your sales processes.
- Inventory management Manage all your invoices, sales and purchase orders, products, and vendors.
- Predictive intelligence Predict the likelihood of a lead converting, a deal closing, or a customer churning.
- Unlimited reports Stay informed about your business performance with unlimited reports.
- Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) Match products to customer requirements and streamline quote management with built-in price rules.
- Custom portals Use portals to grant customers, partners, and vendors access to relevant information in your CRM.
- Customer journeys Build end-to-end, dynamic customer journeys that give your customers a memorable experience.
- Web-to-case forms Resolve customer issues with web-to-case forms that convert problems into support tickets that your reps can follow.
- Customer portals Extend Zoho CRM to your contacts, vendors, or partners with portals.
- Google Ads integration Manage Google Ads campaigns from within Zoho CRM.

Enterprise/user/month

Features List Features List

Running a mature sales org

- Multi-team management Manage multiple sales teams across territories.
- Reporting hierarchy Give every manager a real-time view of only their team's pipeline and performance.
- Custom buttons and functions Create custom buttons and functions to extend the capabilities of Zoho CRM.
- Extended field types Capture the exact data your business needs. Move beyond standard forms. Add file uploads, checkboxes, date ranges, and more.
- Sequential data collection Walk your sales team through a structured, step-by-step process so every deal gets worked the same way and nothing falls through the cracks.
- Approval process Ensure deals move on only after the right person approves it.
- Account Based Marketing Segment your accounts to identify up-sell and cross-sell opportunities.
- Developer sandbox Securely test the changes without affecting production data in a sandbox environment.
- Field-level encryption Protect sensitive customer data at a field-level.
- Extended AI capabilities Gain insights, predictions, and recommendations from Zia.
- QuickBooks integration Sync QuickBook records with Zoho CRM and create quotes and invoices easily.

Local taxes may apply.

Local taxes (VAT, GST, etc.) will be charged in addition to the prices mentioned.

Bigin Express

Features List Features List

First-timer, moving from spreadsheets

- Sales pipeline Track your sales operations by stages with pipelines in Bigin.
- Email integration Connect Gmail, Outlook, Zoho Mail, and other popular email services directly to Bigin.
- Built-in calling Make, receive, and record sales calls without leaving Bigin.
- Calendar integration Manage your day better by syncing your Google Calendar and Microsoft Calendar with Bigin.
- Appointment scheduling Create a no-code online page to capture meeting and appointment bookings.
- Social Ads integration Capture and convert leads from Instagram, TikTok, Google, LinkedIn, and Facebook ads.
- Payment collection Collect payments easily via Stripe and PayPal integrations.
- Custom fields Create custom fields unique to your business.
- Tags Segment, filter, and find your leads faster by adding tags.
- QuickBooks integration Generate, share, and track invoices and estimates right from Bigin. Keep your sales and finance teams on the same page.
